summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, responding to an unsolicited take-over bid by Curaleaf Holdings. Curaleaf offered US$4.00 per Aurora share, comprising 0.3463 Curaleaf shares plus US$0.75 cash, with a capped value of US$5.00 per share. Aurora's board formed a special committee and advised shareholders to take no action until a formal recommendation is made within 15 days. The offer remains open at least 105 days, until December 1, 2026. Advisors include Torys LLP and Kingsdale Advisors. Watch for the Directors' Circular and possible competing bids or negotiation.
